about: Guidance for registering copyright in a work in the UAE.
note: Requirements read from the official AD.iP (Abu Dhabi IP) guidance page on the checked date. AD.iP gives guidance and the filing is made with the Ministry of Economy, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Protection starts when the work is created, so registration is optional
Covers works such as books, music, paintings, photographs, software and architectural designs
documents: Individuals: copy of the author's Emirates ID, both sides
Groups of authors, companies and government bodies: a letter of authorisation
Legal persons: power of attorney from the author or company
channels: AD.iP: 800555, Baniyas Towers, Abu Dhabi, Mon-Thu 8 am to 3 pm, Fri 8 am to 11:30 am
